high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene at what appears to be a railway station during sunset or sunrise. The sky is a gradient of soft blues and oranges, with scattered clouds adding texture to the backdrop. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm glow over the landscape. In the foreground, there are multiple railway tracks running parallel to each other. The tracks are surrounded by gravel and some greenery, including small bushes and trees. On the left side of the image, there is a concrete bridge with an arched design, supported by vertical pillars.
